content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 4.1 License Fees. In consideration for the licenses granted to Corio pursuant to Section 2 of this Agreement, Corio shall pay the license fees specified in EXHIBIT B hereto. Payment terms of such license fees shall be as set forth in EXHIBIT B hereto.
input.rationale: The Fees section (4.1-4.4), Exhibit B Pricing, the Revenue Sharing Fees terms and the Payment Terms all set fixed, negotiated amounts and revenue-share percentages; searches for most-favoured-nation formulations ("most favored", "no less favorable", "lowest/best price", "other customers", "competitive", "discount", "match") returned nothing anywhere in the agreement, including Exhibit D (Sales and Marketing Cooperation) and Section 13 (Shared Resources). There is therefore no undertaking by Corio to give Commerce One pricing or terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, and no obligation to match third-party offers. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on the Customer), and no Vendor-granted MFN exists that would need preserving. No redline required.
